Metadata.title: TopStock CRM
Metadata.description: Sales CRM and inventory for TopStock Wholesale.

Home.tagline: Small start. Same grade. Big orders.
Home.emptyBody: Today’s tasks, meetings and your pipeline will show here once they’re in the CRM.
Home.addName: Add your first name to the greeting

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.body: Try again. If it keeps happening, tell Haider.

Auth.signInBody: Use the email address your invitation was sent to.
Auth.forgotBody: Enter your email address. If it has an account, we’ll send a link to choose a new password.
Auth.forgotDone: If that address has an account, a link is on its way. It works once, for one hour.
Auth.confirmInviteBody: You’ve been invited to TopStock CRM. Start by choosing your password.
Auth.confirmRecoveryBody: This link lets you choose a new password.
Auth.setPasswordBody: At least 12 characters, with lower- and upper-case letters, a number and a symbol.
Auth.mfaBody: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for TopStock CRM.
Auth.setupBody: Every TopStock account needs an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password. It takes a minute.
Auth.scanStep: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
Auth.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
Auth.manualKey: Can’t scan it? Type this key into the app instead:

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don’t match. Try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in isn’t available right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.passwordWeak: Use at least 12 characters with lower- and upper-case letters, a number and a symbol.
errors.passwordSame: Choose a different password from your current one.
errors.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from your app.
errors.codeWrong: That code didn’t work. Codes change every 30 seconds, so use the one showing now.
errors.setupExpired: This setup has expired. Reload the page to get a new QR code.

leads.emptyBody: Leads will appear here once they’re imported, ready to search and work through.

pipeline.emptyBody: Deals will appear here, grouped by stage.

inventory.emptyBody: Products, locations and stock levels will appear here.

tasks.emptyBody: Your follow-ups and to-dos will appear here.

analytics.emptyBody: Sales and stock reports will appear here.

Palette.title: Command menu
Palette.description: Search sections and actions, then press Enter.
Palette.empty: No matches. Try a section name.

Shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
Shortcuts.description: Shortcuts work anywhere except while you type in a field.

errors.invalid: Names can be up to 80 characters.
errors.unavailable: Couldn’t save just now. Try again.
